general.summary: Tod’s SpA is close to securing a €400 million ($439 million) debt refinancing backstopped by the founder’s family that would ease financial pressure on the Italian luxury group, according to people familiar with the matter.

general.title: Anthropic Shares Jump 17% After $107.3 Billion IPO Breaks Record
general.summary: Anthropic PBC shares pared earlier gains to trade 17% above their IPO price after the artificial intelligence lab’s blockbuster $107.3 billion debut broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.
